overlap_correction.R414_vs_R477_pg_ts: 64 previously reviewed parser/template/dictionary/config objects have identical parsed catalog tuples; differing MD5 values are JSON serialization differences, not demonstrated provider drift. Two newly listed unaccent objects: template OID 19149 and dictionary OID 19150. The 551 mapping slots already had R414 baseline coverage; equality of individual mapping slot contents across runs not independently compared here.
overlap_correction.R408_vs_R476_pg_cast: R408 explicitly completed 229/229 casts before R476; new unique coverage not established without a per-object delta comparison.
overlap_correction.R415_vs_R476_event_triggers: R415 previously reviewed all seven complete event-trigger bodies; R476 reinspection cannot add seven new unique baseline items without demonstrated change.
overlap_correction.R401_to_R407_vs_R473_R474: Operator/opclass/opfamily native overlap exists; full item-level extension and metadata reconciliation still pending, do not automatically add successive totals.

performance_guardrail.interpretation: One read-only aggregate snapshot cannot diagnose a persistent bottleneck or justify tuning/production configuration writes.
